note: Logan County's zoning is set out in its Zoning Regulations (2019 PDF) and an official zoning map held by the planning office; no queryable ArcGIS zoning-district service was found. The county's Portico viewer (mygisonline) is a viewer, not a confirmed zoning service; the county's ArcGIS host returned no zoning layer, and Sterling, the largest city, publishes no GIS zoning layer either. The 'Zoning Districts' FeatureServer found on ArcGIS (f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd) has no features around Sterling and is not Logan County's.
